character_not_found.title: Character {character} not found
character_not_found.description:
The Battle.net API no longer finds {character}. Possible reasons: the character was renamed, moved to another realm or deleted, or has not logged in for a long time.

If you renamed or moved the character, open Settings → Devices & services → WoW Charakter, find the character under the Battle.net API entry and choose ⋮ → Reconfigure. Otherwise delete the character there. This notice disappears once the character is found again.

character_changed.title: {character} is a different character now
character_changed.description:
A different character than the one set up now carries the name {character} (the Battle.net character ID changed). This usually happens after a rename, a realm transfer or a deleted and newly created character. Until you confirm, the integration shows no data for it.

Open Settings → Devices & services → WoW Charakter, find the character under the Battle.net API entry and choose ⋮ → Reconfigure. Saving there accepts the current character; enter the new name if yours was renamed.

character_invalid.title: {character} is no longer valid
character_invalid.description:
Blizzard reports the profile of {character} as no longer valid. Blizzard asks applications not to show such data, so the integration shows nothing for this character.

If you renamed or moved the character, choose ⋮ → Reconfigure on the character under Settings → Devices & services → WoW Charakter; otherwise delete it there.

character_changed.message: The name of {character} now belongs to a different character.

character_invalid.message: Blizzard reports {character} as no longer valid.
